/**
 * Matches the first strong directionality codepoint:
 * - in group 1 if it is LTR
 * - in group 2 if it is RTL
 * Does not match if there is no strong directionality codepoint.
 *
 * The form is (?:([strong LTR codepoint])|([strong rtl codepoint])) .
 *
 * Generated by UnicodeJS v (see tools/strongDir) from the UCD; see
 * https://gerrit.wikimedia.org/r/unicodejs .
 */
private static $strongDirRegex = '/(?:()|())/u';
document.getElementById( 'version' ).textContent = unicodeJS.version; function phpEsc( codePoint ) { return '\\x{' + codePoint.toString( 16 ) + '}'; } function phpRegexp( ranges ) { return '[' + ranges.map( ( range ) => { if ( typeof range === 'number' ) { return phpEsc( range ); } else { return phpEsc( range[ 0 ] ) + '-' + phpEsc( range[ 1 ] ); } } ).join( '' ) + ']'; } document.getElementById( 'L' ).textContent = phpRegexp( unicodeJS.derivedbidiclasses.L ); document.getElementById( 'R_AL' ).textContent = phpRegexp( [].concat( unicodeJS.derivedbidiclasses.R, unicodeJS.derivedbidiclasses.AL ) );
